thebstar-shipreel-shipreel-shipreel.description: Turn a pull request into a short narrated walkthrough video (about two and a half minutes) with animated diagrams, code panels, optional screen recordings of the real app, captions, crossfade cuts and an ambient music bed. Runs locally with no paid services by default. Use when asked for a PR video, PR walkthrough, demo video of a change, or "make a shipreel".
